message.content: The largest planet that has been observed and confirmed in the universe is **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius roughly **2.5–3 times that of Jupiter**, making it the biggest planet we know of. (Its mass is estimated to be around 10–20 M_Jup.)
